test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 2 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: _______ a 17 year old girl from Surat has been appointed as regional Ambassador for India by United Nations Environment Programme Tunza Eco-Generation in Sept 2020.
solution:
Correct answer is __**Khushi Chindaliya.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khushi Chindaliya,** a 17-year-old girl from Surat has been scheduled as **Regional Ambassador for India** by the United Nations Environment Programme - **Tunza Eco-Generation.**
 
• She says**, "Impassioned about conserving the environment, I appeal to everyone to spread awareness to safeguard it."**
 
• Brand ambassadors are additionally** hired by the government or a private entity to affect the mindset of targeted customers or societies**.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8f5d0b4e2684b7adbe0bdc43233c85995130167ae1059c67b86d2a238db766d.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) is **the main environmental authority in the United Nations system**.
 
• **UNEP works on delivering transformational change **for people and nature by dessert on the root causes of the three planetary crises of** climate change, nature and biodiversity loss, and pollution and waste.**
